payload.claim: The acceptance criterion requires that passing earned_risk=None 'leaves the column as it was,' and the fold's gate_result handler guards this with `if earned_risk is not None:` before the UPDATE. Every test that exercises an omitted/null earned_risk (test_ledger_appends.py's a3, and test_session.py's non-judged attempts) does so on an attempt whose earned_risk was already None, so it cannot distinguish 'leaves it as it was' from 'always writes the given value, including null.' Deleting the guard so the UPDATE always runs (with earned_risk possibly NULL) keeps every existing test green, including the one whose comment explicitly claims to prove a value is 'never cleared' -- because no test ever sends a null-risk gate_result to an attempt that previously received a non-null one.
